entries.title: America’s Farms and Ranches at a Glance: 2024 Edition
entries.notes: Supports family-farm centrality and small-farm production-share context. Does not prove local prosperity institutions.

entries.title: 2023 Farm to School Census
entries.notes: Supports institutional local purchasing as existing practice. CC purchase floors remain design parameters.

entries.title: Local Agriculture Market Program (LAMP)
entries.notes: Illustrates federal market-access tools; not evidence of finished Food Utility Cooperatives.

entries.title: Opposing note from claim ledger: production value concentration
entries.notes: Production value concentrated on larger family and nonfamily operations; farm-count dominance ≠ production dominance.

entries.title: Opposing note from claim ledger: local definitions, milk share, barriers
entries.notes: Local definitions vary; milk large share of local spending; availability and cost remain barriers.

entries.title: Opposing note from claim ledger: program ≠ farmer-controlled utility
entries.notes: Program existence does not establish farmer-controlled regional utility infrastructure at scale.

entries.title: Unregistered gap: failed food hubs / cooperatives / procurement systems literature
entries.notes: No peer-reviewed failure studies registered in source_registry for this packet. Do not invent. Future packets must register contrary literature before raising confidence.
